description: nhflow_2d_channel_suspended with bed load (S 11 3) and a rigid apron: a DIVEMesh solid box 1 cm high (x 4-5 m), lower than the bottom cell, with S 134 1 (the solids are not erodible, sediment_f::active_solid_nhflow). The apron keeps its top at 0.0100 m (sediment deposits on it), the sand downstream of it is scoured to -3.5 mm in 1500 steps. With S 134 0 the apron was eroded as sand, to 0.0071-0.0097 m.
